details:
This update for ImageMagick fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-62343: heap buffer overwrite in morphology operation when an invalid kernel is provided (bsc#1272575).
- CVE-2026-62946: integer overflow in JNX decoder can lead to heap buffer overwrite when processing extremely large
  files on 32-bit builds (bsc#1272580).
- GHSA-hc76-7mpc-qjqh: code injection in HTML encoder due to incomplete fix of CVE-2026-25797 (bsc#1272579).
